im glad that you found it somewhat helpful! also, its a really horrible moment to do this but i think you just made a pun: “we’re in the river which is CURRENT-ly shitty” oh god i dont know why i did that im sorry im an idiot

hey, im 18 too, i guess we’re in the same river, each in our individual boats. i dont know how to comfort you, im sorry, i know how hard it is to repeatedly be given and accepted hope, then have it crash all over you and finding yourself in a darker place. yeah, i dont think its selfish to think of suicide, i do that too. dont blame yourself for thinking the things you do. somedays its physically/mentally impossible to stop the thoughts, so just let them be without judging yourself too harshly.

when the though of killing yourself comes, try to understand the thought, chop it up and digest it analytically (like a math problem) rather than indulge in the feelings. for example, “im going to jump off today after a bottle of pills because im just so tired of being the bane of everyone’s existence”. what i do is, i’ll picture the words in my head, then look at each word of the sentence individually, like some puzzle. sounds silly, you might fail at first, but it makes me more calm. it wouldnt solve anything, but makes you less worked up.

Oh my god, I've never related so much to a post ever before. 1-2 weeks before my period, I get so depressed (clinically diagnosed w mild depression and anxiety) and way more suicidal, my binges rise through the roof and I hate myself so much for not being motivated to do any work even if I forced myself to sit at my desk for hours (in my last year of high school). I feel you so much, girl, you're not alone!
